import base64,zlib,json;nb=json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode('')));open('/kaggle/working/evon_server_kaggle.ipynb','w').write(json.dumps(nb));exec("ip=get_ipython()\nfor c in nb['cells']:\n if c['cell_type']!='code': continue\n src=''.join(c['source']); print('#### cell', src.splitlines()[0], flush=True)\n r=ip.run_cell(src)\n if not r.success: print('#### STOPPED at', src.splitlines()[0]); break")
